subject: Exec Workshop — suite mix, early-checkin flexibility & billing split
messages:
From: Campbell Hotels Sales <sales@campbellhotels.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal for Redwood exec workshop (Jul 19-21) — preliminary rates attached

Hi Marissa,

It was great speaking earlier. Attached is our initial proposal for the July exec workshop (Jul 19-21) — room block of 48 rooms across Deluxe King / Deluxe Double / 4 Suites. Key items in the PDF: negotiated suite allotment, early-checkin window (no fee for arrivals before 1pm for up to 8 rooms), complimentary welcome reception in the lobby on night 1, and a proposed masterbill split: room charges to Acme (sponsor) and incidental holds to individuals.

A few open items we flagged that we need confirmed to finalize:
- Final suite mix (how many suites do you want held vs. released)
- Whether you want a single masterbill for the company or individual folios for attendees
- Guaranteed arrival time for group checkin (we can set a dedicated checkin desk at 10:30am for an additional $250 flat fee)

I'm copying Sue (operations) on the follow-up once you review. If you want, we can hold the provisional rates for 7 days.

Attachments: Campbell_proposal_Jun12.pdf

Thanks,
Mark H.
Director, Group Sales — Campbell Hotels
sales@campbellhotels.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal for Redwood exec workshop (Jul 19-21) — preliminary rates attached

Forwarding Campbell's proposal. Please review the suite mix and the billing options — Acme (the sponsor) has asked Redwood to coordinate hotel logistics and confirm block terms. Important constraints from leadership:
- We need at least 6 suites for VPs and external execs (quiet floor preferred)
- Early arrivals: several execs will be flying red-eye on Jul 19; we need a firm early-checkin policy (no surprise fees)
- Billing: Acme will cover room charges for sponsors and a handful of attendee rooms; all other incidentals must be individual folios (no corporate hold on incidentals)

Laura — can you draft a quick rooming priority list and mark the names that require suites? Vivek — can you check with finance on the masterbill routing (we may need a split-bill addendum).

Also, I want a single point of contact at the property on the arrival day for expedited check-in.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Events — Redwood Inference

Marissa,

Drafted rooming priorities and attached a preliminary spreadsheet (master_rooming_list_v1.xlsx). Quick notes from my pass:
- 6 suites flagged: 4 for board members (private suites) + 2 for visiting partners (connected rooms requested)
- 10 single-king rooms reserved for speakers with late check-out requests (we'll request noon checkout)
- 8 early arrivals (arriving before 8am on Jul 19) — I recommend we confirm the dedicated checkin desk + the complimentary early checkin waiver for those 8 rooms.

If we go with the proposed masterbill split (room charges to Acme, incidentals to individuals) we should confirm the hotel's process for applying incidental holds and whether they can set a lower hold for verified corporate cards. Also flagged who requires ADA-compliant rooms.

Laura
Sr. Program Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Campbell Hotels Sales <sales@campbellhotels.com>
Cc: Therese Collins <therese@acmeenterprise.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal for Redwood exec workshop (Jul 19-21) — preliminary rates attached

Mark — thanks for the proposal. We have a few requests/clarifications below before we can sign off: 

1) Suite mix: we need 6 suites held as proposed. Please confirm location (quiet floor vs. adjoining to meeting rooms).
2) Early-checkin: leadership requires guaranteed early-checkin for up to 10 rooms arriving before 09:00 on Jul 19, with no additional per-room fee. If you need the $250 desk fee, request it as an option but we prefer it waived.
3) Masterbill split: Acme will cover room charges for sponsor rooms (approx 16 rooms). All incidentals must post to individual folios. Can you confirm the process for incidental holds and whether you can lower the hold to $50 for corporate-card verified guests?
4) Billing & tax paperwork: Vivek (cc'd) will need the hotel's tax ID and an invoice sample prior to DocuSign.

If you can confirm items 1-3 and reissue the proposal, we can circulate for signatures. We also need a short cancellation window to accommodate late headcount changes — can you hold the group rates until Jun 26 (14 days out) with a 5-room attrition allowance?

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Campbell Hotels Sales <sales@campbellhotels.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Therese Collins <therese@acmeenterprise.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal for Redwood exec workshop (Jul 19-21) — updated terms and draft masterbill

Marissa — thanks, great questions. See responses inline: 

1) Suite location: we can hold 6 suites on the 9th floor (quiet executive wing) adjacent to the meeting room elevator bank.
2) Early-checkin: we will waive per-room early checkin fees for the first 10 early arrivals and provide a dedicated checkin desk at 10:00am at no charge. (If arrivals are earlier than 06:00am, there may be a limited number of rooms available; those will be subject to availability.)
3) Incidentals: we can set incidental holds to $50 for verified corporate cards. Individual folios will be used for incidentals while room charges for the 16 sponsor rooms will post to the masterbill.
4) Tax info & invoice sample: attached in the draft masterbill. Also attached: Campbell_masterbill_draft_0620.pdf.
5) Attrition / cancellation: we can hold rates through Jun 26 with a 5-room attrition allowance and standard attrition penalty beyond that.

We also added a DocuSign envelope to capture the masterbill signature and the split-billing addendum. Link: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/XYZ-ENVELOPE-12345

Please confirm ASAP and we'll issue the final contract.

Best,
Mark H.
Director, Group Sales — Campbell Hotels

Subject: Re: Proposal for Redwood exec workshop (Jul 19-21) — updated terms and draft masterbill

Mark — thanks for the fast turnaround and for accommodating the early-checkin waiver and the $50 incidental hold. Confirming: please issue the final contract with the 6 suites on the 9th floor, the dedicated checkin desk at 10:00am, and the attrition terms you listed. We will sign the DocuSign envelope once Vivek confirms the invoice sample and tax ID.

Laura — I've attached the rooming list (master_rooming_list_v1.xlsx) with suite flags and early-arrival notes. Can you reconcile names and mark any special dietary / ADA notes for the front desk? Vivek — please confirm you received the invoice sample in Campbell_masterbill_draft_0620.pdf and confirm the billing flow so I can complete signature.

One small ask from leadership: can the hotel provide a private bell-cart route from the loading dock to the suites to expedite arrival for high-priority execs? If you need a site rep to attest, we can schedule a short call with the hotel's ops manager next week.

Marissa
Director, Customer Events — Redwood Inference
